description: Starts converting one bank or credit-card statement (PDF, scanned image, CSV, QIF, OFX/QFX) into reconciled transactions on the user's stmtai account. Pass the bytes as file_base64 (about 4 MB at most) or as an attached file object; with neither, the result is an upload_required handshake holding a presigned PUT URL (valid 15 minutes) and the website address where the user can upload instead. Limits: 20 MB per file, 60 pages per file, and at most 15 pages are charged for one statement. Returns immediately with status "processing"; the conversion takes 10–40 seconds, so call get_conversion with the returned conversion_id after poll_after_seconds. Pages are charged from the user's plan when the conversion succeeds; failed conversions are not charged. An account with no pages left is refused before anything is uploaded.

file.description: A file attached in the assistant (OpenAI file object). The server downloads it from download_url.

download_url.description: HTTPS URL the server downloads the file from (supplied by the assistant platform).

file_name.description: Original file name reported by the platform.

mime_type.description: MIME type reported by the platform.

file_base64.description: The file bytes as standard base64 (no data: prefix). Inline files are limited to about 4 MB; larger files go through `file` or the website.

file_name.description: File name with its extension, e.g. "jan-2026.pdf". Supported: PDF, PNG/JPG/WEBP/GIF images, CSV, QIF, OFX/QFX.

name: convert_statement
title: Convert a bank statement
